free_tier.stated: No free tier. Plan block read 2026-10-23: Standard $9.99 per month or $29.99 per year, Pro $12.99 per month or $59.50 per year, Premium $14.99 per month or $64.99 per year, and Port Forwarding appears in the feature list of every plan.

egress.terms: Unlimited Speeds and Unlimited Bandwidth appear in the feature list of every plan.; ingress: tcp+udp

interface_detail: Client area under Services, Port Forward Request; no public API for port reservation in the pages read.
tooling: Client area request form; wg-quick or the TorGuard app for the tunnel.
chaining: A static shared or dedicated IP plus a requested port gives a fixed endpoint a service on a free VM can publish behind.

limits.value: a port is a reviewed request, not a self-service toggle: enter the public VPN IP, choose protocol and port, click Submit Request. Note that on occasion the request may need to be approved.
the forward is bound to one public VPN IP: enter the public VPN IP you had taken from the TorGuard software

binding_note: Bandwidth is stated as unlimited, so volume does not bind. The gate is the request workflow plus its approval step, and the requirement to name the exact server IP, which means the port is only useful while a user stays on that server.

identity_cost.detail: An account in the client area is required to submit a Port Forward Request; payment can be made by card or crypto, and the site markets an anonymous purchase path.

reliability_note: A port request can sit in approval; the forward is tied to one server IP, so moving servers loses ingress until a new request.
confidence_note: Measured would need an account, an approved port and a byte count. The plan prices were extracted from the served HTML of the vendor page rather than from its rendered price widget, which is why they are listed as read rather than inferred.

evidence.proved: Port forwarding is a client-area request against a named public VPN IP, TCP or UDP, all ports above 2048 allowed, and requests may need approval.

Unlimited Speeds, Unlimited Bandwidth, Port Forwarding and SSL VPN via WireGuard appear in the feature list; the HTML carries Standard $9.99 or $29.99 per year, Pro $12.99 or $59.50, Premium $14.99 or $64.99.

price_per_tb_month: USD 9.99 per month or USD 29.99 per year (standard); USD 12.99 or USD 59.50 (pro); USD 14.99 or USD 64.99 (premium)
notes: Candidates for a plan matrix that prices three tiers while every tier lists Port Forwarding: (1) the difference is devices and dedicated IP, which the extracted block confirms, since Pro adds x1 Dedicated IP and Premium adds more devices; (2) port count differs by tier, which the pages read do not state; (3) the feature row is copied across tiers as marketing. The first is supported by the per-tier device and IP lines; the second remains open. TorGuard root and product pages intermittently returned HTTP 530 while the knowledgebase path served normally, so the KB path was used.

extras.wg_detail: WireGuard is a listed transport and the port request names the tunnel type: select a protocol and then select the VPN port or Tunneltype, by choosing openconnect or wireguard you will use that tunneltype for your port forward.
extras.volume_stated: Unlimited Speeds and Unlimited Bandwidth appear in the feature list of every plan.
extras.transit_note: Traffic crosses TorGuard servers at the named public VPN IP.
